a.lede: Megaspeed has been accused of funneling AI chips to China after a former executive's affair with Jensen Huang became public.
a.title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

b.lede: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.
b.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
